records.title: Towards Domain-Specific Network Transport for Distributed DNN Training
records.abstract: A domain-specific transport for distributed deep neural network training uses gradient-aware priority queueing and bounded-loss tolerance to reduce tail latency and training time.

records.title: Parrot: Efficient Serving of LLM-based Applications with Semantic Variable
records.abstract: A serving system for large language model applications uses semantic variables and data-flow analysis to optimize pipelines across multiple requests.

records.title: Decentralized Information-Flow Control for ROS2
records.abstract: A decentralized information-flow control design for ROS2 enforces security policies over nodes and messages in robotic systems.

records.title: Flock: A Framework for Deploying On-Demand Distributed Trust
records.abstract: A framework deploys distributed-trust applications on demand and evaluates latency and cost across major cloud providers.

records.title: A Unified Symbolic Analysis of WireGuard
records.abstract: A symbolic analysis models the WireGuard protocol and checks its security properties under protocol-level adversarial behavior.
